folds.name: two_releases
folds.rule: AC-1 journal: R1 and R2 released, nothing superseded

folds.name: ac1_supersede
folds.rule: AC-1: superseded_by(R1) is R2 and R1's entry stays released

folds.name: more_releases
folds.rule: a W2 output and the tombstone are not releases

folds.name: chain
folds.rule: R2 may itself be superseded later

folds.name: two_old_one_new
folds.rule: one new record may replace two old ones

folds.name: on_trial
folds.rule: (e) a supersession counts in its own branch's ancestry only

folds.name: forged_agent
folds.rule: (a) the principal is human

folds.name: forged_script
folds.rule: (a) the principal is human

folds.name: forged_bus_route
folds.rule: (a) the handler added the event

folds.name: forged_class_w2
folds.rule: (a) the entry is W3

folds.name: forged_major_2
folds.rule: (a) the command is major 1

folds.name: forged_event_not_the_params
folds.rule: (a) the parameters commitment is that of {new, old, reason} with the event's old and new

folds.name: forged_params_other_reason
folds.rule: (a) the parameters commitment is that of the opened reason

folds.name: forged_reason_commit_of_another_entry
folds.rule: (a) reason_commit opens to the entry's own reason, not another entry's

folds.name: forged_opening_salt
folds.rule: (a) reason_commit opens to the opening

folds.name: reason_erased
folds.rule: erased reason: the parameters commitment is required but cannot be recomputed

folds.name: reason_erased_unchecked
folds.rule: erased reason: only the presence of the commitments is checked

folds.name: no_params_commitment
folds.rule: the entry records a parameters commitment

folds.name: no_params_commitment_erased
folds.rule: the parameters commitment is required after erasure too

folds.name: forged_other_command
folds.rule: (b) RecordSuperseded only from journal.supersede_record@1

folds.name: forged_with_request_filed
folds.rule: (c) no Request* event next to it

folds.name: forged_with_request_approved
folds.rule: (c) an approved request does not carry a supersession

folds.name: forged_stale_head
folds.rule: (d) head is the branch head before the entry

folds.name: forged_made_up_head
folds.rule: (d) head is the branch head before the entry

folds.name: replayed_event
folds.rule: (d) the same event replayed later is refused

folds.name: concurrent_pair
folds.rule: (d) two supersessions decided against the same head

folds.name: forged_other_branch
folds.rule: (e) R1 and R2 are not released in trial's ancestry

folds.name: fork_after_supersession
folds.rule: (e) a fork created after a supersession sees it

folds.name: fork_after_supersession_again
folds.rule: (e) R1 is already superseded in the fork's ancestry

folds.name: fork_after_supersession_other
folds.rule: (e) the fork may supersede the records not yet superseded

folds.name: fork_before_supersession
folds.rule: (e) a fork created before a supersession does not see it; each branch decides its own

folds.name: fast_forward
folds.rule: (e) a branch fast-forwarded over a supersession sees it

folds.name: fast_forward_then_supersede
folds.rule: (e) after the fast-forward R3 is released at main's head

folds.name: fast_forward_again
folds.rule: (e) R1 is already superseded at main's head after the fast-forward

folds.name: promoted_copy_supersession_skipped
folds.rule: (e) a promoted copy carrying a supersession is skipped, not refused, and supersedes nothing

folds.name: promoted_copy_release_skipped
folds.rule: (e) a promoted copy releases nothing on the target

folds.name: promoted_copy_release_not_released
folds.rule: (e) R3 from a promoted copy is not a released record

folds.name: promoted_copy_by_agent_skipped
folds.rule: (e) promoted copies are skipped before the release origin check

folds.name: release_by_agent
folds.rule: a W3 release by an agent is refused

folds.name: release_by_script
folds.rule: a W3 release by a script is refused

folds.name: release_by_bus_route
folds.rule: a W3 release whose events the routing module added is refused

folds.name: release_by_bus_release
folds.rule: a human W3 entry the commit stage added release protection to is a release

folds.name: agent_w3_tombstone_only
folds.rule: a W3 entry with only the tombstone releases nothing

folds.name: agent_w2_output
folds.rule: a W2 output is not a release, whoever made it

folds.name: unknown_parent
folds.rule: every logical parent is an entry folded before

folds.name: folded_twice
folds.rule: an entry is folded once

folds.name: two_events
folds.rule: one RecordSuperseded per entry

folds.name: extra_key
folds.rule: exactly the keys head, new, old

folds.name: missing_key
folds.rule: exactly the keys head, new, old

folds.name: not_a_digest
folds.rule: every value a digest

folds.name: uppercase_digest
folds.rule: lowercase digests

folds.name: body_not_object
folds.rule: the body is an object

folds.name: no_reason_commit
folds.rule: the header records a reason commitment

folds.name: self_supersession
folds.rule: old and new differ

folds.name: old_not_released
folds.rule: a W2 output is not a released record

folds.name: new_not_released
folds.rule: new is a released record

folds.name: tombstone_not_released
folds.rule: the tombstone is not a record

folds.name: old_already_superseded
folds.rule: old not yet superseded

folds.name: new_already_superseded
folds.rule: new must not be superseded

folds.name: supersede_outputs_are_not_releases
folds.rule: a supersession entry's outputs release nothing

folds.name: refusal_is_fatal
folds.rule: (f) the fold stops at the first refused entry
